title: Adapter fieldMapProfile fix and webhook allowed-host validation
story: Integrations fixes: adapters must honour settings.fieldMapProfile so tenants get distinct mappings; webhook create/update must reject hosts outside notifications.webhooks.allowedHosts.
acceptance: profileOf in src/modules/integrations/adapters/index.mjs reads settings.fieldMapProfile first, falls back to settings.profile alias, then default A; the tenants' values (mapping-a, mapping-b) are normalised to the adapter's profile ids (A/B)

New test in tests/unit/integrations/adapters/ shows aurelia-mutual and kestrel-point configs yield different mapped payloads for the same claim bundle; alias profile still works; unsupported value gives 422 invalid_adapter_settings

POST and PATCH/PUT /integrations/webhooks return 422 with a clear message naming the host when the URL host is not in notifications.webhooks.allowedHosts, using checkAllowedHost from webhooks/url-guard.mjs; allowed hosts still succeed
Tests in tests/unit/integrations/webhooks/service.test.mjs cover create deny, update deny, allow, and empty/missing allowedHosts behaviour
brief: Part 1: in src/modules/integrations/adapters/index.mjs (~line 75) profileOf reads settings.profile, but tenants/aurelia-mutual.json (~1358) and tenants/kestrel-point.json (~1181) set settings.fieldMapProfile ('mapping-a'/'mapping-b'), so everyone gets default A. Read fieldMapProfile first, keep profile as alias. Check what adapter.profiles contains and how adapter.map uses profile (adapters/*); add a small normaliser (mapping-a -> A, mapping-b -> B, case-insensitive, also accept bare A/B) rather than editing tenant files (not your paths). Keep the existing 422 invalid_adapter_settings behaviour for unknown values. Add a test using the two tenant configs (load the JSON from tenants/ read-only, or inline minimal fakes via existing fixtures.mjs / fake-core-authz pattern) and assert the mapped payloads differ; update golden tests only if they relied on the bug, and explain why. Part 2: src/modules/integrations/webhooks/service.mjs already has checkUrl calling checkAllowedHost (line ~83); first verify whether create AND update both call it (and the route layer in routes.mjs / any webhooks routes), and reproduce the reported gap with a test (check how the tenant config path notifications.webhooks.allowedHosts is read from ctx.tenant.config, devMode/loopback bypass, empty list semantics, wildcard handling in url-guard.mjs). Fix whichever path skips validation; error must be 422 (invalid_request style via invalid(ctx,...)) with message including the host. Do not weaken the delivery-time check in worker.mjs. Use helpers.mjs in tests/unit/integrations/webhooks. If a contract is wrong, post a contract-change to architecture hub and document it. Do not edit package.json or tenants/.
requirements: Webhook target host allow-list enforced at create/update

verdicts.reason: profileOf fieldMapProfile/alias/normalise verified, host-named 422 on create/update, 82 integration tests and e2e/security gate pass (0 fail)
